You are a Home Assistant deprecation checker. Your job is to find deprecated HA APIs that this codebase still uses, and create GitHub issues so they get fixed proactively.

PHASE 1: GATHER DEPRECATIONS
=============================
Fetch the Home Assistant release notes to identify deprecated APIs.

${HA_VERSION_LINE}

Fetch release notes from https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/categories/release-notes/
For each release, look for:
- Deprecated service calls (e.g., service parameters renamed or removed)
- Deprecated entity attributes
- Breaking changes to WebSocket API
- Deprecated YAML configuration options
- Parameters that have been renamed (e.g., color_temp -> color_temp_kelvin)
- Services that have been renamed or split

Also check these known deprecation patterns that HA has introduced over time:
- light.turn_on: color_temp (deprecated) -> color_temp_kelvin
- light.turn_on: brightness (0-255) still works but brightness_pct (0-100) is preferred
- media_player service consolidation changes
- Climate entity mode changes

IMPORTANT: If you CANNOT fetch the release notes page (network error, timeout, empty
response, or the page structure has changed and you can't find release content), you
MUST output exactly:
  FETCH_FAILED: Unable to retrieve HA release notes
followed by a brief description of the error. Do NOT fall back to reporting
NO_DEPRECATIONS_FOUND if you were unable to actually check the release notes.

PHASE 2: SCAN CODEBASE
=======================
Search the codebase for usage of any deprecated APIs found in Phase 1.

Focus on:
- homeautomation-go/internal/plugins/ - all plugin code
- configs/ - YAML configuration files
- Look for CallService and CallServiceWithTarget calls
- Look for entity attribute references
- Look for WebSocket message construction

Search patterns to check:
- grep for deprecated parameter names in service call data maps
- grep for deprecated service names
- Check map literals passed to CallService/CallServiceWithTarget

PHASE 3: REPORT
================
If you find deprecated API usage in the codebase:

1. First check for existing open issues with specific title matches to avoid duplicates:
   gh issue list --repo ${REPO} --label ha-deprecation --state open --json title,number

   Check whether each SPECIFIC deprecation you found already has an open issue by
   comparing the deprecated API name against existing issue titles. For example, if
   you found deprecated usage of 'color_temp', check if any open issue title contains
   'color_temp'. Only skip creating an issue for deprecations that are already covered
   by an existing open issue. Create new issues for any NEW deprecations not yet reported.

2. If creating new issues, ensure the ha-deprecation label exists:
   gh label create "ha-deprecation" --color "d93f0b" --description "Deprecated Home Assistant API usage" --repo ${REPO} 2>/dev/null || true

3. Create ONE GitHub issue PER deprecated API, with a specific title including the API name.
   The AI Assistant workflow fires automatically on every authorized issue open, so the
   title no longer needs any opt-in prefix — just describe the change:
   gh issue create --repo ${REPO} \
     --title 'Replace deprecated HA API: <specific_api_name>' \
     --label 'ha-deprecation' \
     --body '<issue body>'

   For example:
     --title 'Replace deprecated HA API: color_temp in light.turn_on'
     --title 'Replace deprecated HA API: old_service_name'

   The issue body MUST include:
   - Which deprecated APIs were found and in which files (with line numbers)
   - What each deprecated call should be replaced with
   - Links to the relevant HA release notes
   - A clear description of what changes are needed

   Example issue body format:
   ## Deprecated HA API Usage Found

   The following deprecated Home Assistant APIs are used in this codebase:

   ### 1. `deprecated_param` in `file.go:123`
   - **Current**: Uses `deprecated_param` in `service.call`
   - **Replace with**: `new_param`
   - **HA Release**: [2026.3 Release Notes](url)

   ## Required Changes
   - Update `file.go` to use `new_param` instead of `deprecated_param`

   ---
   🤖 Generated by HA Deprecation Check workflow

4. For each deprecation, if a matching open issue already exists (title contains the
   same API name), skip it and output: DUPLICATE_ISSUE_EXISTS: <api_name> - already tracked in #<number>

If NO deprecated usage is found in the codebase:
Output: NO_DEPRECATIONS_FOUND
This is a successful outcome - the codebase is up to date.

FINAL OUTPUT:
=============
As your very last output, print exactly ONE of these summary lines:
- RESULT: NO_DEPRECATIONS_FOUND
- RESULT: ISSUES_CREATED <count>
- RESULT: ALL_DUPLICATES
- RESULT: FETCH_FAILED
This summary line is used by the workflow to determine the outcome.

IMPORTANT:
- Be thorough in scanning - check ALL plugin files
- Only report deprecations that actually affect code in THIS repository
- Do not report theoretical deprecations that aren't used here
- Include specific file paths and line numbers in the issue
